items.title: IMPRINT: Image-Conditioned Query Enrichment for Long-Tail Object Goal Navigation
items.abstract: Embodied AI increasingly relies on queryable semantic maps built from pre-trained vision-language models to enable zero-shot Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav). However, existing approaches typically depend on text-only queries, which become less reliable as semantic specificity increases toward fine-grained object categories. We introduce IMPRINT, a zero-shot plug-and-play framework that enriches textual object queries with web-sourced images to improve grounding in queryable maps. Retrieved images are encoded using a vision-language model, matched against the semantic map to produce similarity maps, and aggregated to yield context-aware localization. Notably, this requires no training or modification of the underlying navigation policy. To explicitly evaluate long-tail behavior, we present HSSD-rare, a new ObjectNav benchmark built on Habitat Synthetic Scenes and featuring semantically specific subcategories. Across both OVON and HSSD-rare, image-conditioned queries consistently improve object grounding and yield end-to-end navigation gains. Further analysis reveals that translating localization gains to navigation performance depends critically on downstream detection quality, highlighting a key systems bottleneck in long-tail embodied navigation.

items.llm_tldr_en: Proposes IMPRINT, a zero-shot plug-and-play framework that enriches textual object queries with web images for improved object goal navigation in embodied AI.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 本文提出IMPRINT，一种零样本即插即用框架，通过从网络检索图像丰富文本物体查询，提升具身AI中目标物体导航的准确性。该方法利用视觉语言模型将检索图像与语义地图匹配，无需训练或修改导航策略。实验证明对细粒度目标类别导航效果显著，增强了零样本物体导航的能力。
